description:
Change the script or its settings; only revise spends credits.

save: replace the active version's text (the old text is lost: show the
user the current script first), then run Analyze Script. Notation, never
read aloud: `[SCENE: <visual direction>]` as its own paragraph directs
the storyboard for the narration after it, until the next one, over the
director style. `<break time="1.5s" />` is the only thing that makes the
voice pause (about 0.5s between thoughts, 1.0s between sections; one tag
with the total, never two in a row). A paragraph starting `Name: "..."`
is that character's dialogue. A delivery cue in square brackets inside
a line (`[laughs]`, `[sighs]`, `[whispers]`) shapes how it is said; keep
it inline, never on its own line. MiniMax performs sounds such as
laughs, sighs, breathes, gasps and coughs and drops other cues.

activate_version: switch to another version (each generated script is
one). revise: an AI rewrite of a passage or the whole script in the
narrative voice; returns revised_text without saving it: splice it in
and save.

action.description: save: content; activate_version: script_id; revise: instruction, optional selected_text; settings: script_target_minutes and/or voice_mix; set_concept: visual_concept

instruction.description: revise: what to change, e.g. "make the intro punchier"

script_id.description: activate_version: a version id from script_read

script_target_minutes.description: settings: length of the next generated script, in minutes

selected_text.description: revise: the exact passage to rewrite; omit for the whole script

name: script_edit
title: Edit the script
